episode_title: Post-Election Market & Jobs, Why Gas Prices Could Stay High, Trump's Arch Blocked
script_en: Post-Election Market & Jobs, Why Gas Prices Could Stay High, Trump's Arch Blocked.
The October jobs report will show whether hiring picked up after a weak September, even as inflation continues to outpace wages and markets reel from a sharp selloff.
Democrats are promising relief from high fuel prices, but Congress has limited power to lower them quickly and analysts say prices could stay elevated for months even if the war with Iran ends.
A federal judge blocked construction on President Trump’s 250-foot D.C.
arch for 14 days, setting up a broader fight over his efforts to reshape the capital and the checks courts and a new Democratic Congress may impose.
